inputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original pixel-art wall material for a fantasy first-person dungeon tool. Create a square, straight-on, orthographic elevation of an ORIGINAL rugged stone wall. The entire canvas is wall surface, with no perspective, floor, ceiling, doorway, window, characters, text, symbols, heraldry, or border. Pixel art with crisp deliberately placed pixels, rich but restrained hand-shaded stone textures, clear clusters rather than smooth gradients, similar craft density to modern high-resolution RPG pixel-art portraits. Distinctive visual direction: warm umber and muted slate stones with scattered thin mineral-green seams; irregular large masonry blocks and small chips, no iconic fantasy motifs. Even lighting from upper left. Pattern should be horizontally repeatable; left and right edges meet naturally. 1:1 square.

Entirely original design, no recognizable franchise motifs. Square canvas.
